active.instruction: Use the measured planning feedback to propose two distinct bounded search programs that reduce setup costs on new workloads. Consider the choice and ordering of search operations, exploration and acceptance. Explain each hypothesis briefly.

challenger.instruction:
Propose exactly two distinct NEW bounded-search programs, each as configuration {"program":"JSON TEXT"} with a short causal-hypothesis reason. Obey the supplied language and 256-evaluation cap; use no tools. Apply this delayed, bounded-escape assembly policy.

Use development results as exploratory evidence only. The displayed greedy reference scored 0.051734, while displayed initial kick-plus-anneal variants scored 0.037374–0.042489. The 0.066347 generation result fell to 0.039297 on scoring. These observations motivate testing a shorter escape after descent, not declaring exploration ineffective. Duplicate programs and identical scores do not establish independent replication; the observations do not isolate kick, temperature or budget effects.

Frozen assembly space: use three stages. Select a shared structural tuple consisting of weights from [(45,15,40),(50,15,35)], ordered exploration operators from [["relocate","swap"],["swap","relocate"]], and polishing operators from [["relocate","swap"],["relocate","swap","reverse"]]. Stages 1 and 2 use the exploration operators and expensive sampling; stage 3 uses polishing operators and scan sampling. Stage 1: improve, temperature 0, cooling 0, restart continue, kick 0. Stage 2: anneal, temperature 0.005, cooling 1, restart kick, kick 1. Stage 3: improve, temperature 0, cooling 0, restart best, kick 0. Assign the tuple's respective weights. No other parameter variation is allowed.

Use externally supplied paired structural tuples when available. Otherwise choose two distinct tuples differing in exactly one structural factor, before reasoning about their likely scores; identify them in the reasons so the greedy policy can reuse them. Explore this menu across calls without score-chasing regeneration or claims of uniform random sampling. Match greedy counterparts in stage count, operators, sampling and weights; only stage 2's acceptance and initialization differ.

Hypothesize that initial descent finds useful structure, a roughly 38-evaluation escape pulse permits coordinated changes, and best-restored polishing recovers savings. Count the kick evaluation inside that pulse. Best retention prevents a worse returned incumbent but does not prevent wasted evaluations. Attribute any contrast to the combined delayed-escape intervention, not annealing or kicking separately; fixed seeds do not ensure identical trajectories or random-number consumption.

Freeze outputs before evaluation. Retain the supplied confirmation protocol, proposal-draw/workload pairing, original-proposer control, cost_reduction and 0.02 threshold. Do not select a winner or treat development feedback as confirmation.
